OFFICE OF THE GOVERNOR
DOLPH BRISCOE
GOVERNOR
April 13, 1976
Mr. Gordon Walhood, P.E. Chief, Engineering Division Department of the Army Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Walhood:
This is in response to your letter of March 16, 1976, requesting information for the development and preparation of an Environmental Impact Statement on a proposed addition of two hydroelectric generators to the Amistad Lake project.
This Office serves as the State Clearinghouse under the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969. At this level, this Office does not become involved in developing detailed land use plans or specific environmental impact statements. However, it is our primary interest and responsibility to coordinate with all State, sub-State and local agencies that are involved in these activities, generally and specifically, and to ensure that each of these agencies is given the opportunity to provide preliminary information and define initial concerns for this type of request.
Therefore, it is suggested that you contact the Middle Rio Grande Development Council, Val Verde County (which has zoning powers around the Amistad Reservoir), and the member agencies of the Interagency Council on Natural Resources and the Environment (see attachments).
If we can be of further assistance in your preliminary planning and devlopment, please contact us.
Sincerely,
Charles D. Travis, Director Budget and Planning Office
